result.summary: The page is generally well-designed and functional. Found a few minor visual/content issues: a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal carousel, a meaningless '-0%' discount badge, and a partially cut-off category chip at the right edge.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated at the right screen edge without a clear affordance that more content exists horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade/gradient or peek of the next card to signal horizontal scrollability, and ensure truncated text uses a consistent ellipsis.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a '-0%' discount badge, which is meaningless and looks like a data/logic error (a zero percent discount).
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0, or only render it for genuine promotions.

issues.description: A category filter chip is partially cut off at the far right of the category row (after 'Healthy'), with no visual cue that the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge gradient fade or ensure the scroll indicator communicates additional categories are available.
